final_prompt: Wide 2.35:1 editorial technology illustration, HD-2D. A flat pixel-art paper request travels on a physical workbench through a small language selector, past a shelf of resource cards, and emerges as a translated validation notice. Show these three distinct stages in one coherent scene, no readable text. Three-quarter view with foreground rails, a clear middle ground and background shelf. The paper is crisp 2D pixel art; workbench and shelf are volumetric 3D with pixel-textured materials. Warm directional light illuminates all objects with grounded contact shadows. Teal, cream and amber palette. 2D pixel-art subjects with crisp stepped silhouettes and deliberate pixel clusters, integrated into a volumetric 3D environment with stylized pixel-textured surfaces, coherent perspective and foreground-midground-background depth, shared directional lighting and grounded contact/cast shadows, a sharp focal plane with restrained depth of field where helpful, controlled highlights and subtle atmospheric separation, a scene-specific palette, readable at thumbnail size; no voxel-built characters, no smooth plastic figurines, no full-frame mosaic filter, no excessive bloom or blur. No text, logos, screenshots, fake code, charts, floating icons or clutter.
